summary: A notice from Alex McKenzie about address changes after the RAND IMP was temporarily removed and a new IMP installed at ISI. The RAND TENEX became the ISI TENEX. It gives new addresses, one of which was corrected in RFC 405.

plainLanguage.summary: This notice explains how network addresses changed when people and a computer moved from RAND to ISI. It also says the RAND connection was expected to return with its former number.

subtitle: A brief notice records address changes after the RAND IMP was temporarily removed.

tldr.problem: The RAND IMP was temporarily removed while a new IMP was installed at ISI, and some RAND people and computers moved there.
tldr.mechanism: The notice gives the ISI IMP number and the Network Address for the TENEX host at ISI, then says what would happen to the RAND IMP.
tldr.outcome: The RAND IMP was expected to return as number 7, while the IBM 360/65 at RAND would keep address 7. The unit metadata says RFC 405 updates this notice.

today: The unit metadata says RFC 404 is updated by RFC 405. This short notice records a network address change in 1972.

sections.title: The Move from RAND to ISI
sections.content: The RAND IMP was temporarily removed from the network, and a new IMP was installed at ISI. Some people and computers from RAND moved to ISI. The RAND TENEX is now the ISI TENEX.
sections.plainLanguage: The RAND TENEX computer moved to ISI, where a new network connection point was installed. The old RAND connection was temporarily taken out.

sections.title: The ISI TENEX Address
sections.content: The ISI IMP has number 86 in decimal. The TENEX at ISI is Host number one, so the notice gives its Network Address as 86.
sections.plainLanguage: The ISI connection is numbered 86. The notice gives the TENEX computer there the Network Address 86.

sections.title: The Expected Return of the RAND IMP
sections.content: The notice says the RAND IMP is expected to be re-installed early the following week. It will still be IMP number 7, and the IBM 360/65 at RAND will still have Network Address 7.
sections.plainLanguage: The RAND connection is expected to return as number 7. The IBM 360/65 there is expected to keep Network Address 7.
